## Add get_jobs_for(func) lookup (2026-11-04)

The owner asked for a way to look up scheduled jobs that run a given function, with tests. They said they keep holding Job objects only so they can cancel them later. The aim is to let callers find and cancel jobs by function without keeping those references.

The first exploration (observation #1, 2026-11-04) found that the scheduler already has tag-based job lookup but no function-based lookup. That gap is what the request fills.

Memory records no implementation, tests, PR or release yet. The request is still at the exploration stage, around 15%. Nothing has stalled or been reworked.
